Keeping bees

Can I keep a hive on my plot? Yes, with a letter from the committee, and only on the plots along the far hedge. How many hives may I have? Two, and a third in the swarming season. Who do I tell if my bees swarm? Ring the warden, who has the number of a keeper in the village and a spare box.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
